title: Make a class video
instruction: Put the tasks in order so that each one comes after what it depends on.
steps: Show the video to the class
debrief: Each task depends on the one before: no topic, no script; no footage, nothing to edit. If you can spot the dependencies, you know in what order to share out the work.
why: Without a topic you don't know what to write about.
The script says what to film.
You film according to the script.
You can only edit footage you have shot.
Subtitles and music are added to the edited video.
You can only show a finished video.
